scope: 历史候选证据归档；不是当前 main 的性能认证，也不是新的测试结果。

provenance.limitation: 保留汇总、逐轮指标、摘要和关键源码身份；原日志、截图与完整源码冻结仍在 tmp/bench，不构成独立复现包。

comparison_contract.capacity_policy_note: 配置入口仅改变固定缓存档；384 MiB 同时沿已有有界邻区预热，192 MiB 不执行该额外预热。结果是档位策略整体对照，不能归因于纯容量。
comparison_contract.statistics_note: medians 是三个独立轮次指标的中位数；total slow 是计数合计；max_frame 是三轮最大值。wall low1_fps 为最慢 ceil(1%*n) 帧平均时长的倒数，不等同于引擎 p1_fps。

failures.cause: zoom-out endpoint missed after consecutive HLOD handoffs

failures.original_hypothesis: fixed WASD direction reached clamped map boundary and did not move away from player
failures.original_hypothesis_status: insufficient: boundary-aware input still failed in all three v31 returns
failures.confirmed_cause: modal UI released WASD; unchanged phase did not resend key after input reopened
failures.evidence: final-v31-192-matrix-1.json: phase 8 initial distance 12-16 px in three runs, coinciding with modal selection; v32 restores held input and retains original 100 px gate

failure_investigation.candidate_hypothesis: At 192 MiB, allow full 96 MiB guarded handoff retry during rapid zoom when two display cuts fit; keep union budget verification. Choose return setup direction using actual map bounds and forecast zoom.
failure_investigation.comparison: Same 192 MiB cache, 96 MiB display, combat, camera and unchanged assertion thresholds; only wide handoff toggle differs.

diagnostic_trace.note: v31 带诊断的慢帧摘录；v32 只修测试驱动。不得混入 final-v32 无追踪三轮统计，也不能相加父子桶或推定 GPU 原因。
